Qualcomm Hiring Engineer Freshers Software Engineering
August 1, 2026Jobs

Qualcomm is inviting applications for the Engineer position in Hyderabad, Telangana. This opportunity is ideal for engineering graduates with strong fundamentals in C programming, operating systems, embedded systems, and computer architecture who are looking to build a career in system software and low-level platform development.

Engineers at Qualcomm work on cutting-edge technologies powering smartphones, automotive platforms, IoT devices, and next-generation computing systems.

About Qualcomm

Qualcomm is one of the world’s leading semiconductor and wireless technology companies. It designs innovative processors, chipsets, connectivity solutions, and software platforms that power billions of connected devices worldwide. Qualcomm’s technologies play a critical role in mobile computing, artificial intelligence, automotive systems, networking, and edge computing.

Details	Information
Company	Qualcomm

Job Type	Full-Time
Location	Hyderabad, Telangana
Qualification	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
Experience	Freshers & Early Career
Key Responsibilities

As an Engineer, you will:

Develop and maintain low-level system software.
Write efficient and secure C code.
Work with operating system internals and embedded software.
Debug system-level software and hardware interactions.
Collaborate with engineering teams on software design and implementation.
Contribute to software quality and coding best practices.
Analyze system requirements and technical documentation.
Support platform development and system optimization.

Joining Qualcomm offers the opportunity to:

Work on world-class semiconductor technologies.

Work on next-generation mobile, automotive, AI, and IoT platforms.
